title: A banana is a berry, but a strawberry is not!
question: Did you know a banana is a berry, but a strawberry is not?
answer: To plant scientists, a banana is a true berry because its seeds are inside soft flesh, but a strawberry is not because its seeds are on the outside.

visual.what: A yellow banana on the left and a red strawberry on the right, with big question marks above them. Huy, Hùng, Bối and Beo peek in from the bottom of the frame.

parts.text: Did you know a banana is a berry, but a strawberry is not?
But it has berry in its name!

visual.what: A simple cut-open blueberry. Seeds sit inside the soft flesh, with arrows pointing to them and a label that says seeds inside.

parts.text: Plant scientists say a berry has its seeds inside soft flesh.
So what is inside a banana?

visual.what: A banana cut across. Soft flesh all the way through, and the tiny flower tip at one end. Hùng holds it up with a big smile.

parts.text: A banana grows from part of a flower, and the part we eat is soft flesh inside its peel. Shop bananas have no big seeds, but scientists still call it a berry.

visual.what: A big strawberry with arrows pointing at the little dots on its skin, labeled tiny fruit with a seed inside. A second strawberry rolls away across the table.

parts.text: Now look at a strawberry. The little dots are on the outside. Each dot is a tiny fruit with a seed inside!

visual.what: A tomato, a bunch of grapes and a banana, each with a gold berry badge. A red strawberry stands to one side with no badge.

parts.text: Tomatoes and grapes are true berries too.

visual.what: All four friends cheer around a table with a banana, a strawberry and a tomato. A big sign says Ask Huy with a follow button.

parts.text: So a banana is a berry, and a strawberry is not! Follow Ask Huy for more surprising facts.

facts.claim: A banana is botanically a berry.
In a true berry the seeds are inside the fleshy part, and strawberries are not true berries because their seeds are on the outside.
Each apparent seed on the outside of a strawberry is an achene, a tiny fruit with a seed inside.
Bananas, tomatoes and grapes are true berries, while strawberries and raspberries are not.

description: A banana is a berry, but a strawberry is not! Find out why with Huy, Hùng, Bối and Beo.
